blessing.note: This is my prayer for you this year.
blessing.verse: “The Lord bless thee, and keep thee: the Lord make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee.”

finale.line: Today and every day after it, I'm yours.

letter.line: If I'm ever going to become love, I can't do it without you.
paras: Before anything else, I want to say thank you. Thank you for existing. Thank you for being exactly who God made you to be.
God used you to change my life. Big time. I see His hand in how you came to me, and I will never take it lightly.
I never knew I could love someone this much, or that I could understand love the way I do now. It all started with you.

memory.quote: It was amazing. You were amazing. You still are.
memory.text:
You had done your makeup, and it was the first time I was seeing it in person. You looked so beautiful that I just stood there, stunned.

Then I kissed you. I didn't plan it. It happened.
memory.title: Our first photo shoot.

reasons.note: There is a light in you that God put there. I feel it every single day.
reasons.title: Your beauty, inside and out.

reasons.note: You always try to understand me. You never stop trying.
reasons.title: You're always there.

reasons.note: The way you hide your face when I look too long? I love that one.
reasons.title: Your shyness.

reasons.note: I'll never get tired of being the reason.
reasons.title: That blush.
